messages:
eli: quick heads up: preprod CI scanner found a service-account JSON embedded in a test fixture tarball. not in prod.
fern: thanks. can you paste the redacted snippet and commit? we'll treat as compromised until proven otherwise.
eli: snippet: `{ "type": "service_account", "client_email": "ingest-test@redwood-preprod.iam.gserviceaccount.com", "private_key_id": "..." }` commit: b3f2a9
vault-bot: [Alert] repo-scan match=sa-json path=tests/fixtures/ingest/key.json ticket=SEC-3505
fern: immediate steps: 1) revoke any keys for that SA 2) run artifact + repo sweep 3) generate new key, envelope-encrypt with KMS, store ciphertext in Vault 4) enable Vault audit on secret/ingest-test and ship logs 90d. who can revoke now?
eli: I can. running `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=ingest-test@redwood-preprod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-preprod` now.
infra: infra will add a CI block rule to fail on SA JSON and add artifact scanner rule using regex `(\{\s*"type"\s*:\s*"service_account"|"private_key"\s*:)`.
fern: ensure KMS key policy is locked down: only infra-decryptor SA + ops group get cryptoKeyDecrypter. run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` and remove any legacy bindings.
eli: revoked keys: ids ["7a8b9c"]. created new key and encrypted: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create - --iam-account=ingest-test@... | gcloud kms encrypt --key=ingest-wrap --keyring=partner-keys --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | vault kv put secret/ingest-test wrapped=@-` (wrapped stored)
vault-bot: [Info] enabled audit log file=/var/log/vault/ingest_test_audit.log retention=90d
compliance: please add a brief timeline and list of affected resources to SEC-3505. we'll triage notification needs.
fern: post-incident actions: add pre-merge hook to block SA JSON, add repo sweep job, publish runbook snippet for KMS envelope + Vault ciphertext, and schedule RBAC review for KMS keys next sprint.
eli: timeline: detected 1834567000, revocation 1834567120, wrapped stored 1834567480, scans running. closing notes to SEC-3505 after artifact sweep.
infra: thanks everyone, good catch. tabletop next week to rehearse.
